contact.basis: simulated coating sampled at the actual foot with renderer exposure; wet acoustic interpretation

method: Uninterrupted native RAF walk from production seed; actual keyboard run/walk, AutoWalk, three views/profiles, month/day/weather choices without repositioning. Every complete frame read back after adaptive resolution. First fifteen minutes exclusively clear weather; rare electric events originate in the ordinary manual storm. No speed-up, repair teleport, replacement soundtrack or weakened collisions. SwiftShader software at 400×260 DPR1; probes and concurrent validation add overhead. Source hashes checked unchanged.
